_comment: Fixed shape IDs used in the experiments reported in the paper (Rotation-Invariant Vectorized Shape Representations).

clustering_experiment.description: Clustering accuracy vs discretization parameter m. For each seed set, 10 distinct fish IDs are picked, and 9 random-rotation copies of each are added to form a 100-shape collection. k-means with k=10 is run on the rotation-invariant sketch for m in [8, 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 128, 256, 512, 1024]. The curve in the paper is the mean +/- 1 std band over the 6 trials below.
clustering_experiment._seed_note: These are the chosen_shapes lists baked into each data/rotatedSampleByArea*.json file. The rotation angles themselves were drawn uniformly at random from [0, 2*pi). To regenerate a fresh trial with new IDs / angles, edit chosen_shapes in src/sampleRotatedVersion.py and rerun.

knn_experiment.description: 5-NN retrieval over all 1100 SQUID fish using the m=128 star-shaped signature.

shape_table_figure.description: 4x6 grid of fish outlines used in Figure 3 of the paper (shape_table_4x6.pdf).

resolution_figure.description: Single fish used to illustrate the effect of discretization m = 36, 120, 360 (Figure 1, kk102_triple_styled.pdf).

roc_figure.description: Single fish used to illustrate the Reverse-of-Complement operation (Figure 2, kk53_60_styled_COMBINED.pdf).
